mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases are not followed by tighter monetary policy within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decreases are not followed by increased consumer spending within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of periods following RSAFS increases, or RSAFS increases are not followed by earnings growth within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increases are not followed by earnings growth within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% YoY, the combined effect signals tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL is not followed by tighter monetary policy within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, the combined effect signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low UNRATE and high PAYEMS is not followed by increased consumer spending within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the past 3 months signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to its impact on the broader economy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decreases are not followed by broader economic weakness within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% over the past 3 months, the combined effect signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY and INDPRO decreases > 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low GDPC1 growth and decreasing INDPRO is not followed by broader economic weakness within 6 months.
